scope: uncombined complete core; identity v11, drawing language r4b; no 3D production
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / character model design. One standalone complete Brave Fist core robot, the UNCOMBINED machine from reference image 1. Full body in a clear neutral three-quarter stance on warm ivory, portrait 1024x1536, all hair, shoulders, fists and feet inside the frame with margin. No text, badges, poster layout or hangar background.

Image 1 controls the actual core identity and EVERY major piece: a complete slender athletic orange/ivory humanoid fighting robot, simple armored helmet with small orange side horns and a central cyan forehead sensor, narrow cyan eye visor, very long flowing orange-white mechanical mane, white chest plate with its orange insignia, ordinary orange shoulder shells, dark compact waist joints, orange cylindrical oversized impact forearms with visible thick armored fists, white/orange thighs and shin plates and athletic feet. It is a whole piloted robot with its own torso, arms and legs, not an internal skeleton, detachable head or hollow chest insert. Keep that exact family and silhouette rather than inventing a different core.

Image 2 controls ONLY the new accepted clean KINETIC_CEL drawing/color/material language and family continuity with the later combined form. Do NOT give the core the combined helmet: its helmet must remain simpler than the larger silver/orange combined crown. Do NOT add any bomber cockpit, swept wings, jet engines, passenger train shells, external tracks or knee drills. Those come from external machines in the combined form and must be absent here. The core has its own big closed fists, but they are one reinforcement stage lighter/smaller than the combined image 2 fists. The matching hands, head sensor, mane, chest, thighs and feet should make the same underlying robot recognizable.

Rendering: sophisticated hand-inked mecha animation key art, large clear orange/ivory/graphite color planes and one crisp hard shadow band, restrained panel seams, no photoreal PBR, no noisy all-over scratches, no luminous aura or giant energy rings. Cyan limited to forehead/eye and a small forearm emitter line. Keep an agile tall heroic humanoid proportion, no squat toy body. This is a source design illustration, no diagrams or extra robots.
